blurb: Help TrustLLM collect data for our future Germanic LLM!
blurb1: The main objective for TrustLLM is the development of an open, trustworthy and factual LLM, initially targeting the Germanic languages. This will create the foundation for an advanced open ecosystem for next generation modular and extensible European trustworthy, sustainable, and democratised LLMs. The focus on Germanic languages can serve as a blueprint for future activities in other families of languages.
description: This platform is a fork of the open-source platform, Open Assistant, by LAION.

faq_items.q0: How far along is this project?
faq_items.a0: We are in the early stages of development, working from established research in applying RLHF to large language models.
faq_items.a1: TrustLLM is a project with the following collaborating partners: Linköping University (LiU), Fraunhofer (FHG), Forschungszentrum Julich (FZJ), Lindholmen Science Park (LSP), Mideind (MID), University of Iceland (UOI), Copenhagen University (UCPH), Alexandra Institute (AXI), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Nederlandse Organisatie voor Toegepast Natuurwetenschappelijk Onderzoek (TNO), Academy for Artificial Intelligence (AKI). As well as external collaborators: The Centre for Language Technology at the University of the Faroe Islands and ScaDS.AI (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence).
faq_items.a2: This data collection platform is a fork of the Open Assistant project. The code and models for that project are licensed under the Apache 2.0 license and the same holds for this fork. Furthermore, the data collected on this platform will be released under the CC BY 4.0 license.
faq_items.q3: Will the data collected be released?
faq_items.a4: Yes, the data collected for TrustLLM on this platform will be free to use and modify.
